name: NASA C-MAPSS FD004 turbofan run-to-failure (six operating conditions / two fault modes) — hourly PHM telemetry — remaining useful life (RUL) (univariate RUL forecasting bundle)
citation: A. Saxena and K. Goebel (2008). "Turbofan Engine Degradation Simulation Data Set", NASA Prognostics Data Repository, NASA Ames Research Center, Moffett Field, CA. Official repository: https://www.nasa.gov/intelligent-systems-division/discovery-and-systems-health/pcoe/pcoe-data-set-repository/. Download mirror used by this pipeline: https://zenodo.org/records/15346912 (CMAPSSData.zip). Related paper: Saxena, A., Goebel, K., Simon, D., & Eklund, N. (2008). Damage Propagation Modeling for Aircraft Engine Run-to-Failure Simulation. International Conference on Prognostics and Health Management (PHM08).
license: U.S. government / NASA Ames PCoE public research data (public domain in the U.S.; attribute Saxena & Goebel 2008). Zenodo mirror redistributes the same archive.
description: Turbofan RUL under multi-condition / multi-fault settings. This bundle forecasts `remaining_useful_life`. Source: NASA C-MAPSS / PCoE turbofan degradation simulation (Saxena & Goebel 2008); pipeline download = Zenodo https://zenodo.org/records/15346912/files/CMAPSSData.zip?download=1. Exemplar longest unit only; hourly cadence via cycle→hour mapping; 543 rows; 2020-01-01T00:00:00Z..2020-01-23T14:00:00Z. Windows: context_window=168, forecast_horizon=14. C-MAPSS is the PHM community gold-standard for remaining useful life benchmarking.
preprocessing: 1. download_cmapss.py: GET Zenodo record 15346912 CMAPSSData.zip → data/maintenance/cmapss/raw/; unzip to CMAPSSData/.
2. transform_cmapss.py: read train_FD004.txt (whitespace-separated) with the same 26-column C-MAPSS layout.
3. FD004 = six operating conditions + two fault modes (hardest C-MAPSS subset).
4. Select the longest run-to-failure unit by max(cycle) as the TempusBench exemplar trajectory.
5. remaining_useful_life = max_cycle - cycle; failure_probability_14d = 1.0 iff RUL <= 14.
6. Drop near-constant sensors {T2, P2, P15, epr, farB, Nf_dmd, PCNfR_dmd}; retain informative sensors.
7. Centered rolling-median window=5 + clip to mean±4σ.
9. Write cmapss_fd004_unit*.parquet then TempusBench CSV (context_window=168, forecast_horizon=14).
